row.body: The route map is folded around a key marked for the next shift; a note says the crew will return after checking the water line.
row.title: Here for the next shift

sidecar.gloss: A planned return follows a water-line check, but no arrival is recorded.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response crew could have held the key during a utility inspection; the note does not identify what the crew expected to find.

row.body: the broom bears a treated-seed stain and the camera a closure mark. one rope knot holds both objects together.
row.title: two traces on the broom

sidecar.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.
